caption: Salt pans, Trapani
composition: Pink salt ponds with wooden windmills · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist stands on the dirt causeway between the salt pans, where shallow pink ponds stretch across the foreground divided by white salt-crusted banks. A large white windmill with latticed sails stands left of center, with two smaller mills dotting the distance to the right, and the sea and hazy mountains beyond. The 08:10 morning sun is bright under a partly cloudy sky, turning the pond surfaces from rose to pale silver.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the salt pans in Trapani under partly cloudy morning light
